throughputPlan.currentParentReason: N5.4.A is LISTO_REAL after six REVIEW_FIRST accepted preflight facets. N5.4.B must resolve only the concrete domain/contract decisions surfaced by that preflight, without leaking into persistence/API/frontend implementation and without inventing unsupported business semantics.

roadmap.note: N5.4.A is LISTO_REAL. N5.4.B is current in canonical COLA order. N5.4.C and N5.4.D are prearmed only as dependency-gated roadmap successors and must not execute before their predecessor closes.

J1.prompt: Use only docs/VAEP_AUTHORITY.md plus live Desarrollo and the original N5.4 COLA state. Resolve the N5.4.B domain contract for source-backed absolute revenue, historical cost and gross-profit values using existing Venta/VentaDetalle persisted monetary fields and invariants. Write only docs/qa/N5_4_B_ABSOLUTE_PROFITABILITY_CONTRACT.md. State exact invariants, reconciliation boundaries and any unresolved dependency; do not invent percentage, shipping, discount-allocation, persistence, API or frontend semantics. If no domain code change is required, document grounded N/A with evidence. Desarrollo only.

J2.prompt: Use only docs/VAEP_AUTHORITY.md, live Desarrollo and original N5.4 COLA. Resolve the N5.4.B contract evidence for margin percentage denominator, zero-denominator behavior and derived rounding. Search current code/tests/docs for an authoritative existing convention; never invent a business rule. Write only docs/qa/N5_4_B_MARGIN_PERCENT_CONTRACT.md with source-backed decision if one exists, otherwise the exact unresolved contract and why implementation must remain dependency-gated. Do not implement persistence/API/frontend. Desarrollo only.

J3.prompt: Use only docs/VAEP_AUTHORITY.md, live Desarrollo and original N5.4 COLA. Resolve domain identity semantics for profitability grouping by product, category, seller and customer, including the current-vs-historical category caveat from N5.4.A. Write only docs/qa/N5_4_B_GROUPING_IDENTITY_CONTRACT.md. Ground every decision in existing entities/report/query contracts; if historical category identity is not source-backed, record that exact dependency instead of inventing a snapshot rule. No C+ implementation. Desarrollo only.

J4.prompt: Use only docs/VAEP_AUTHORITY.md, live Desarrollo and original N5.4 COLA. Resolve whether the repository already defines a source-backed rule for allocating/reconciling sale-header discounts into product/category profitability groups. Write only docs/qa/N5_4_B_DISCOUNT_ALLOCATION_CONTRACT.md. If a rule exists, cite its exact code/test authority and invariants; if not, record the unresolved causal contract and prohibit invented allocation. No persistence/API/frontend implementation. Desarrollo only.

J5.prompt: Use only docs/VAEP_AUTHORITY.md, live Desarrollo and original N5.4 COLA. Resolve whether shipping cost participates in the source-backed N5.4 profitability/gross-margin contract. Inspect existing sale calculations, reporting tests and documentation. Write only docs/qa/N5_4_B_SHIPPING_COST_CONTRACT.md with the authoritative rule if proven; otherwise identify the exact unresolved contract and keep implementation dependency-gated. Do not invent treatment or implement C+. Desarrollo only.

J6.prompt: Use only docs/VAEP_AUTHORITY.md, live Desarrollo and original N5.4 COLA. Resolve the N5.4.B domain/contract boundary for row-scope and sensitive profitability disclosure using existing relational permission/report precedents.
